reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and keeps the existing isDailyWeekendSkip, adding one isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that replaces every d.isWeekend check.

duplication.why: No new logic is copied; the pre-existing per-site daily-skip filter and skipWeekend ternaries are each edited in the same way rather than consolidated.

placement.why: Holiday-aware day classification and moving live in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend rule; call sites only pass config.holidays.

scope.why: Only the weekend-rule sites, the recur config type and the rschedule data mapping are touched.

maintainability.why: A single predicate defines which days are skipped, though each call site still threads holidays and repeats the daily-skip filter shape.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts isWeekendOrHoliday, used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate's daily search, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange
